# PAAS-008: Docker Swarm ports are restricted to cluster peers

- **Group:** Coolify and Dokploy
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Dokploy runs on Docker Swarm. The swarm management port 2377/tcp, node gossip on 7946/tcp and udp, and the VXLAN overlay on 4789/udp must only be reachable by other cluster nodes: an open management port or overlay lets outsiders talk to the cluster control plane or inject overlay traffic.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ss -tulnp | grep -E ':(2377|7946|4789) '; ufw status verbose
```

## How to fix it

Allow 2377/tcp, 7946/tcp and udp and 4789/udp only from the other nodes' addresses (or the tailnet), deny them from anywhere else.

## What a fix can break

Blocking a real peer splits the swarm; list every node before narrowing the rules.
